name: Tokyo
tagline: Neon, rain, vending-machine coffee at 3 a.m.
journal:
Tokyo doesn't whisper — it hums. The first night I walked from Shinjuku to Shibuya without a map, just following the glow. Crosswalks the size of small towns, and somehow no one bumped into anyone.

I ate cold soba in a basement no bigger than a closet. The chef hadn't said a word the whole meal, then bowed when I left like we were old friends.

What I'll remember: the silence inside the noise. A train car packed shoulder to shoulder, and not a single phone playing audio out loud.

photos.alt: A narrow Tokyo alley with red lanterns
